text:
Priya: heads-up — p99 spike on /v1/generate.us-east shortly after we shifted routing weights. p50 steady, p95 modest bump, p99 huge outlier in the 5m bucket.
Ben: can you paste the slice link? want endpoint + region breakdown. sometimes CPU fallback tail causes this.
Priya: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/latency?endpoint=/v1/generate&region=us-east — p50=34ms, p95=78ms, p99=420ms in last 5m.
Ruth: yikes. sample_count for that slice is ~120. small N -> percentile volatility. do we show sample_count in the UI today?
Omar: we don't. frontend only displays p50/p95/p99 numbers and sparklines currently.
Ben: backend question: are rollups computing weighted quantiles or plain t-digest on samples? if sampling isn't uniform, plain quantiles will be biased.
Ruth: checked rollup job yesterday — it runs t-digest over collected samples, no sample_weight applied. so yes, assumes uniform sampling.
Omar: that matches theory: fallback routing changed distribution and sampling prob differs by route/size; bias appears at tail.
Priya: immediate UX ideas: (1) show "samples: N" next to percentile values, (2) add a small "sampled" pill when data source is sampled, (3) annotate dashboard timeline with routing-policy-change events.
Ben: low-risk. let's also run a one-off weighted quantile job for that 5m window to compare.
Ruth: SQL to run in analytics:
```sql
SELECT
  endpoint,
  approx_weighted_quantile(0.99, latency_ms, sample_weight) AS p99_weighted,
  approx_quantile(0.99, latency_ms) AS p99_unweighted,
  sum(sample_weight) AS total_weight,
  count() AS sample_count
FROM latency_sampled
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND region='us-east' AND time > now() - interval '5 minutes'
GROUP BY endpoint;
```
Omar: running it in staging now, will paste results.
Deploy Bot: frontend/console-ui v3.2.1 canary by Ben :rocket:
QA Bot: smoke tests queued for v3.2.1 — ETA 7m
Ben: also propose frontend tooltip text: "This percentile is computed from sampled telemetry. Low sample counts can make tails unstable. See docs: /docs/console/percentile-provenance"
Priya: agreed. transparency first. UX change can ship quickly while infra debates weighted rollups.
Omar: pasted results: p99_unweighted=420ms, p99_weighted=86ms, sample_count=118, total_weight=1248. Weighted looks much closer to p95.
Ruth: strong signal sampling bias. long-term we should either compute weighted t-digest in rollups or fallback to full-traffic aggregations for dashboard percentiles. both have tradeoffs.
Ben: engineering estimate for weighted t-digest change?
Ruth: moderate complexity. need compatibility tests and storage of weight metadata. rough estimate 3-4 dev days + QA.
Priya: action items: Omar attach query output to PLT-824, Ben ship sample_count badge + "sampled" pill in canary, Ben add timeline annotation for routing weight change, Ruth scope weighted rollup change and add cost/impact note.
Ben: PR: https://git.redwood/p/console-ui/changes/2142
Omar: uploaded CSV to the ticket and linked staging query id.
Priya: we'll monitor canary tomorrow AM and decide if infra change is warranted. thanks all :white_check_mark:
